description: At most one current measurement slot owned by the bearer principal. Read serverTime after serialization with acquisition and presence; use it consistently for availability, slot expiry and attempt inspection. Expiry is exclusive. NONE includes expired, released or absent leases and is not a historical or idempotency result.

slotExpiresAt.description: Expiry of the unreleased occupying lease, strictly later than serverTime. For ACTIVE, it equals attempt.expiresAt. Retained terminal acceptance does not itself release capacity.

attempt.description: ACTIVE or TERMINAL at the envelope's serverTime. Terminal acceptance takes precedence over the retained lease. This is identity and state, never authority.
